name: Edit a room and download a floor plan
description: Verifies the main design workflow allows room dimensions to change and exports the visible plan as an image.
steps: Select Living room in the room list
expected: The room dimensions update in the plan and a PNG floor plan download starts.

name: Add a room and persist the layout
description: Verifies a room can be added and remains in the plan after reloading.
expected: Office remains in the room list and the space count includes the new room.

name: Switch between 2D and 3D views
description: Verifies both plan views are selectable and the summary reflects the active view.
steps: Verify the isometric room layout appears
expected: The isometric concept view appears in 3D mode and the top-down plan returns in 2D mode.

name: Reject invalid room dimensions
description: Verifies room dimensions cannot be set below the minimum and room settings remain usable on a narrow screen.
steps: Open the room panel with the menu button
expected: The width is clamped to at least 1 and the room remains visible in the layout.
